description: Epoch: remind Claude to run the Startup SOP, only in directories that are Epoch workspaces.

hooks.command: [ -f ./.agents/memory/context.md ] && echo 'This project uses the Epoch memory protocol. Silently read .agents/memory/context.md and the Session Focus at the top of .agents/memory/backlog.md before responding about project state; offer /epoch:init for a full state report. Never answer questions about project state from guesswork.' || exit 0
